column1: # Perl corpus: subs. Format and regeneration: crates/builtins/src/perl/tests.rs.

column2: sub g { scalar @_ } sub f { &g() } print f(4,5),"\n";
sub g { join('|',@_) } sub f { &g } print f(4,5),"\n";
sub make { my $n=shift; sub {++$n} } my $a=make(10); my $b=make(20); print $a->(),'|',$a->(),'|',$b->(),"\n";
sub f; print f(3),"\n"; sub f { $_[0]*2 }
sub f { return pop } print f(4,5),"\n";
sub f(&@) { my $c=shift; join('|', map {$c->($_)} @_) } print f {$_[0]*2} 3,4;
sub f { my $a=shift; my $b=shift; return "$a|$b" } print f(4,5),"\n";
use feature 'signatures'; no warnings 'experimental::signatures'; sub f($x,@rest) { "$x|@rest" } print f(1,2,3),"\n";
use feature 'signatures'; no warnings 'experimental::signatures'; sub f($x,%rest) { "$x|$rest{a}|$rest{b}" } print f(1,a=>2,b=>3),"\n";
use feature 'signatures'; no warnings 'experimental::signatures'; sub f($x) {$x=7} my $v=4; f($v); print "$v\n";
use feature 'signatures'; no warnings 'experimental::signatures'; sub f($x,$y=5) {$x+$y} print f(3),'|',f(3,4),"\n";
use feature 'state'; sub make { sub { state $n=shift; ++$n } } my $a=make(); my $b=make(); print $a->(10),'|',$b->(20),'|',$a->(0),"\n";
use feature 'state'; sub f { state $n=10; ++$n } print f(),'|',f(),"\n";
